name: Local Loopback Pool
description: A local loopback execution target that keeps runtime truth in the repository while exercising the external worker boundary.

name: Mock Remote Shell Pool
description: A mock external worker pool that dispatches through the external gateway contract and falls back to the local shell adapter.

name: Remote HTTP Shell Pool
description: A single-control-plane remote worker pool that executes shell tasks through the remote worker API and reports heartbeat/completion callbacks back to the control plane.
